boundary_exception.statistical_treatment: All 10 IEBC rows remain in constituency, county and national totals. None is attached to a current Atlas ward polygon until the boundary source is reconciled.
boundary_exception.reason: The 2022 IEBC schedule uses Mandera East wards Arabia, Township, Neboi, Khalalio and Libehia, and Lafey wards Sala, Fino, Lafey, Waranqara and Alango Gof. The current external Atlas ward layer instead reflects the configuration introduced by High Court orders in 2012, including Bulla Mpya and a different placement of Libehia. The Court of Appeal allowed the appeal on 5 July 2013 and set aside those High Court orders. Spatially assigning the 2022 voter rows to the current polygons would therefore require an unsupported boundary assumption.
boundary_exception.court_of_appeal_case: Hassan & 2 others v Attorney General & 3 others [2013] KECA 496 (KLR), Civil Appeal 281 of 2012
boundary_exception.publication_rule: Prefer a visible data gap over false geographic precision.
